headline: Advances in Quantum Codes, Simulation, and Cryptography
summary: Today's papers present major strides across fault-tolerant quantum computing, quantum characterization, and quantum information bounds. Structural innovations in lifted product codes streamline logical operations and code surgery, while fast circuit simulators and open-system learning algorithms enhance classical evaluation tools. Additionally, new frameworks define precise geometric and cryptographic limits for measurement states and encryption.

themes.title: Quantum Error Correction & Lifted Codes
themes.body: Advances in qLDPC architectures introduce lifted product code constructions and canonical logical computation schemes that significantly reduce space overhead and seed gadget requirements for fault-tolerant code surgery.

themes.title: Quantum System Simulation & Characterization
themes.body: New classical algorithms push quantum system modeling, featuring SymFT for high-speed Clifford-Pauli circuit simulation and an optimal time-evolution algorithm for learning open Lindbladian dynamics.

themes.title: State Manipulation & Cryptographic Bounds
themes.body: Geometric and information-theoretic frameworks address fundamental limits in quantum mechanics, detailing optimal measurement state preparation via squeezing ellipses and security bounds for unclonable Pauli encodings.

connections.body: 2607.28621 and 2607.28605 both exploit lifted product qLDPC code symmetries to streamline fault-tolerant logical computation and reduce code surgery gadget overhead.
